projectDescription: A React-based developer portfolio website styled as a Windows XP desktop environment, featuring draggable windows, a taskbar, Start Menu, and built-in apps like Notepad, Internet Explorer, File Explorer, WordPad, and Outlook.
keyFeatures: Windows XP-style desktop UI with draggable, resizable windows
Window Manager context for global state management
Built-in apps: Notepad, Internet Explorer, File Explorer, WordPad, Outlook, System Properties
Taskbar with active window tracking and Start Menu
Desktop icons with double-click to open
URL hash-based routing for deep linking to apps
publicApiSurface: WindowManagerContext — openWindow(app), closeWindow(id), minimizeWindow(id), restoreWindow(id), focusWindow(id), toggleStartMenu()
App definitions array (id, title, icon, content, appType, defaultSize, defaultPos)
